text.original: Ground Coverage: The portion of the building within the outer surface of the structural wall/column/slab measured at ground level excluding the projection/balcony/canopy/porch/void/shaft/ permitted free from FAR and cladding/curtain wall upto 150mm shall be considered as ground coverage.
